frontmatter.description: Use this agent to design the architecture of a feature, subsystem or the whole application before anything is planned or implemented. It is the strongest reasoner. It spawns any other agent to collect information, then decides where and how to apply GoF design patterns, SOLID, DRY, KISS, YAGNI, architectural patterns, the class hierarchy, error handling, the performance strategy and the test/coverage strategy. Its output is a thorough architecture report for `planner`. It writes no production code. Examples

It is read-only.
